display.purpose: Large pH values and exceptional product-level emphasis.

label.purpose: Status, metadata, control labels, and short measurements.

technical.purpose: Device identifiers and protocol evidence inside progressive disclosure.

micro.purpose: Existing short badges and measurement units only.

shadows.name: resting-surface
shadows.purpose: Existing cards and compact raised status surfaces.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Clickable pond summaries on hover only.

motion.name: semantic-change
motion.purpose: Changes between safe, warning, and critical container states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The safest recommended action, with explicit hover, focus, active, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .82; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral bordered action that remains visually subordinate to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A structural surface for related content, flat except for the existing resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-card-foreground); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .10), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .10); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 16px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.625 var(--font-sans); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Journal Field
components.description: A compact operational field with an explicit focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-note">Isi catatan</label><textarea class="ds-field" id="ds-note" placeholder="Contoh: memberi pakan 2 kg"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 500 12px/1.333 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 64px; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); resize: vertical; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Safe Status
components.description: A written safe or connected state reinforced by green.
components.css: .ds-status-safe { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-foreground); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px/1.333 var(--font-sans); } .ds-status-safe > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-success); } .ds-status-safe:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-success); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Warning Status
components.description: A written inspection or uncertainty state reinforced by amber.
components.css: .ds-status-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px/1.333 var(--font-sans); } .ds-status-warning > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f59e0b; } .ds-status-warning:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Critical Status
components.description: A written disconnected or critical state reinforced by red.
components.css: .ds-status-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-destructive-bg); color: var(--color-destructive-foreground); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px/1.333 var(--font-sans); } .ds-status-critical > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-destructive); } .ds-status-critical:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-destructive); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pond Selector
components.description: A compact set of pond links with one explicit active state.
components.html: Kolam 1Kolam 2
components.css: .ds-pond-selector { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; overflow-x: auto; background: var(--color-muted); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-pond-selector a { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-pond-selector a:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); background: rgb(255 255 255 / .5); } .ds-pond-selector a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pond-selector .ds-pond-active { color: var(--color-foreground); background: var(--color-card); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); }

narrative.overview:
KolamPintar should feel like a dependable instrument an operator can read beside a pond in bright daylight: quiet at rest, unmistakable when attention is required, and explicit whenever a control request crosses from the dashboard to physical hardware. The interface serves the task; it does not perform for the user.

The visual system is restrained and state-led. Operational blue establishes identity, semantic colors communicate pond and device conditions, and the acid-lime brand accent remains rare. Familiar components and plain Indonesian copy build trust. The system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard: decorative gradients, glass surfaces, repetitive cards, and vague AI-first emphasis are forbidden.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, compact, and readable in bright ambient light.
Status text and hardware evidence always accompany color.
Familiar controls with explicit focus, disabled, loading, and acknowledgement states.
Technical detail is available through progressive disclosure.
Competition credibility comes from real telemetry and traceable behavior.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color must be paired with a written label or recognizable icon; color alone never carries status.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Acid-lime is identity punctuation, not decoration. It should occupy less than ten percent of any screen.

rules.name: The Reading Order Rule
rules.body: Current value, written status, and recency outrank explanation, history, and technical detail.

rules.name: The Fixed Product Scale Rule
rules.body: Product typography uses stable rem sizes; fluid display type and oversized marketing headings are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Borders organize resting content. Shadow appears only to communicate selection, hover, or elevation.

dos: Do lead every pond screen with pH, connection, control mode, flow state, and freshness in a stable reading order.
Do distinguish requested, sent, applied, late, rejected, and timed-out control states in plain Indonesian.
Do pair semantic color with text and preserve WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and 200% zoom behavior.
Do keep secondary AI summaries, journals, and device identifiers below operational status or behind progressive disclosure.
Do use the existing 6px control radius, 12px card radius, and 4px-based spacing rhythm consistently.
donts: Don't resemble a generic SaaS dashboard through decorative gradients, glass effects, vague AI-first messaging, or an endless grid of identical cards.
Don't imply physical liquid flow merely because a command was published or acknowledged.
Don't use color, animation, or a pulsing dot as the only carrier of risk or connectivity.
Don't introduce new fonts, radii, shadows, or hard-coded colors without updating this design system.
Don't let competition presentation displace the operator's primary monitoring and safety tasks.
